scope: Independent source and pin review only; no sample arrays, model payloads, remote files, or empirical fit were read or run.

checks.source_pins: All 27 files named in the final preparation manifest were independently rehashed from the local checkout and matched; no missing or mismatched paths.
checks.runtime_closure: The pinned runtime map contains 20 exact module names. The entrypoint verifies source pins before imports, requires exact equality between the observed package-prefixed module set and the map, and checks each resolved module path against its pinned source path.
checks.coordinate_and_objective: The block-major T kron I112 transform has the stated direction zB=S zA; betaA=S.T betaB and the mapped S R S.T penalty preserve the same predictions and objective. Congruence mapping of H and b is correct. The exact steepest-descent step uses the unnormalized quadratic consistently; the normalized-risk gradient differs by weight_sum and its step by the inverse scale only.
checks.gap_and_reports: Iteration zero retains absolute initial H-energy and relative gap 1.0. Terminal per-target and mean relative gaps are present. The direct native-B versus mapped-A check now returns one scalar per target, and the fit invariant gates compare the mapped systems and optima.
checks.data_and_scoring: Fit-only scored stride-40 rows determine normalization; EMA histories reset at sequence start and are built across each full sequence before mask/stride selection. Fit targets form the weighted objective. Evaluation labels are passed to the canonical scorer only after both fixed optimization paths complete; predictions are converted to FP32 before scoring.
checks.resource_shape: The fit design is preallocated at 31,808 by 449 FP64 entries and full feature histories are built one sequence at a time for both fit and evaluation. This is consistent with the stated memory envelope; retaining all complete-sequence feature histories would not be.
checks.fail_closed_numerics: The source checks finite input/features, Gram identity, finite and positive-definite systems, mapped H/rhs errors, mapped optimum and direct-prediction errors, finite gradients/curvature/steps/objectives, objective monotonicity, and selected scorer values. Failed checks raise before a success result is written.
checks.synthetic_receipt: The bound author receipt reports 8 synthetic/metadata tests passed, an exact 20-module cold import closure with payload-reader sentinels untouched, and Ruff check/format passes. I verified the corrected direct-map scalar and mean-gap fields in the frozen source; I did not rerun the suite.

known_validation_note: The author test receipt records 69 NumPy matmul RuntimeWarnings on macOS and explicitly says their cause is unknown. This review does not infer a cause; finite/SPD/objective/map guards are present, and any corresponding invariant failure in the bounded run must remain an incomplete result.
interpretation_limits: The analytic Gram is for infinite unit impulse responses, not the empirical finite-history feature covariance.
The comparison isolates this fixed same-span FP64 coordinate-conditioning procedure, not GRU conditioning, production FP32 training, general optimizer behavior, or public performance.
The R3 exposed panel and component/drop-one summaries do not provide independent replications or an unbiased full-fold estimate.
decision: Source is suitable for root transport review. This is not permission or admission to execute; exact external staging, source/sample identity checks, and resource gates remain separate.
